research_question: Does the source-preserving three-turn projection retain and expose answer-bearing evidence on a formally released conversation dataset that was not used by V1-V2.4, while reducing visible context and preserving a zero-false-support boundary?

official_source.name: LoCoMo
official_source.paper_title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents

freshness_audit.reason: The formal LongMemEval baseline indexed all 500 rows and subsequent development and held-out analyses exposed its full distribution. LoCoMo was absent from the repository and local evaluation data before this preregistration.

independent_variable.name: visible_memory_representation
independent_variable.intervention: source-preserving projection of at most three original turns selected by question-token overlap and restored to original order

dataset_partition.algorithm: sort conversations by sha256(split_salt + ':' + sample_id); first four are the one-use holdout and the remaining six stay unopened reserve

eligibility: question and answer are non-empty strings
official evidence is non-empty and all evidence turns belong to one session
the official answer occurs verbatim, case-insensitively, in the complete target session
target and hard-negative sessions are each at most 32000 characters
hard negative is a non-evidence session in the same conversation and does not contain the official answer
case_selection.ordering: within each holdout conversation sort eligible questions by sha256(selection_salt + ':' + sample_id + ':' + qa_index + ':' + question), then take the first three
case_selection.hard_negative: choose the eligible non-evidence session with maximum normalized lexical overlap with the question; break ties by sha256(selection_salt + ':' + sample_id + ':' + qa_index + ':' + session_key)
case_selection.copyright_boundary: Committed case manifests contain identifiers, source indices, and hashes only. Official conversation text, questions, and answers remain in the ignored external dataset and are reconstructed locally.

representation_contract.complete: timestamp followed by every original speaker-labelled turn in the target or hard-negative session
representation_contract.projection: timestamp plus at most the top three non-empty original turns by normalized question-token overlap; ties use source order; selected turns are serialized in source order
representation_contract.source_preservation: no paraphrase, summary, translation, answer insertion, or generated memory is allowed

cost_reporting: mean and p95 latency by representation
evidence_boundary: This preregistration covers one narrow source-preserving evidence-support mechanism on twelve fresh LoCoMo single-hop questions. Even a pass cannot establish full LoCoMo QA ability, full-pipeline memory quality, persona similarity, or production readiness.
